parts.title: Build your first system
parts.description: From a web request to a working link service.

days.title: How a web request works
days.objective: Trace a web request from your browser to a service and database, then follow the response back.

days.title: Size your first service
days.objective: Turn incoming traffic into a server budget.

days.title: Code the capacity planner
days.objective: Make the capacity calculation executable.

days.title: Add a cache
days.objective: Reduce database work without losing the source of truth.

days.title: Share the traffic
days.objective: Implement predictable request routing.

days.title: Code the read path
days.objective: Choose between a cache hit, database read, and missing key.

days.title: Connect the pieces
days.objective: Check your first system from request to response.

days.title: Keep routing through failure
days.objective: Build a router that skips unhealthy servers.

days.title: Recall the read path
days.objective: Revisit request flow and caching with fresh scenarios.

days.title: Speed and volume
days.objective: Separate response time from completed work.

days.title: Measure what users feel
days.objective: Read percentiles and error rates.

days.title: Find the constraint
days.objective: Spend effort on the resource that limits the system.

days.title: Scale with a reason
days.objective: Choose horizontal, vertical, and automatic scaling.

days.title: Plan for failure
days.objective: Estimate availability and avoid shared failure points.

days.title: Performance checkpoint
days.objective: Check capacity, latency, and failure trade-offs together.

days.title: Recall under load
days.objective: Practice capacity and latency after a gap.

days.title: Give data a home
days.objective: Choose durable records, keys, and indexes.

days.title: Model the relationships
days.objective: Connect users, links, and events with stable identities.

days.title: Keep unique identities
days.objective: Remove duplicates while preserving the first occurrence.

days.title: Count events
days.objective: Turn a stream of event names into useful counts.

days.title: Separate customer work
days.objective: Group jobs without mixing tenants.

days.title: Make a change safely
days.objective: Explore transactions, isolation, and durable commits.

days.title: Choose a useful index
days.objective: Work through a relational read and write path.

days.title: Handle concurrent changes
days.objective: Protect invariants and diagnose query work.

days.title: Design a document
days.objective: Choose embedding and references for real access patterns.

days.title: Storage checkpoint
days.objective: Connect data modeling, transactions, and database choices.

days.title: Recall correctness
days.objective: Revisit durable changes and stale cache entries.

days.title: Build the batcher
days.objective: Combine grouping, deduplication, and batch limits.

days.title: Prepare to build
days.objective: Recall failure routing and bottleneck diagnosis.

days.title: Build a tiny link service
days.objective: Connect storage, cache reads, updates, and request handling.

parts.title: Serve data at scale
parts.description: Spread data across machines, make reads fast, and expose a clean API.

days.title: Copy and split the data
days.objective: Replicate for reads and durability, then shard when one machine is not enough.

days.title: Find the right shard
days.objective: Place keys on a ring so adding a node moves only a slice of the data.

days.title: Validate a request limit
days.objective: Turn a raw query value into a safe, bounded page size.

days.title: Write fast, read later
days.objective: See how log-structured storage turns random writes into sequential ones.

days.title: Store rows across a ring
days.objective: Model wide rows for a partitioned, replicated store.

days.title: Design for a key-value store
days.objective: Pick partition and sort keys that match the access pattern.

days.title: Recall data placement
days.objective: Revisit replicas, shards, and the hash ring with fresh scenarios.

days.title: Data at scale checkpoint
days.objective: Bring replication, hashing, and distributed stores together.

days.title: Keep hot data in memory
days.objective: Use Redis structures and expiry for the reads that matter most.

days.title: Normalize an incoming event
days.objective: Accept messy input at the boundary and hand clean events onward.

days.title: Cache with simple keys
days.objective: Compare a plain distributed cache with a richer data store.

days.title: Search instead of scan
days.objective: Index documents so text queries do not read every row.

days.title: Inside the inverted index
days.objective: Follow how terms map back to documents and scores.

days.title: Recall storage engines
days.objective: Compare on-disk log structures with in-memory caches.

days.title: Store big blobs
days.objective: Put files and media where durability is cheap and reads scale.

days.title: Serve from the edge
days.objective: Move static reads close to users with a CDN.

days.title: Return a bounded page
days.objective: Page through results without loading everything.

days.title: Fast reads checkpoint
days.objective: Combine caches, search, storage, and the edge.

days.title: Recall bounded reads
days.objective: Revisit input limits and search indexes.

days.title: Design a clear API
days.objective: Name resources, choose status codes, and version safely.

days.title: Choose REST, RPC, or events
days.objective: Match the interface style to the interaction.

days.title: Let clients ask for shapes
days.objective: Serve one query language with a schema and resolvers.

days.title: Call services with contracts
days.objective: Use typed contracts and streaming between services.

days.title: Recall API boundaries
days.objective: Revisit resource design and paging with fresh scenarios.

days.title: Keep a connection open
days.objective: Push updates over a long-lived connection.

days.title: Speed up the wire
days.objective: See what changes when HTTP moves to multiplexed streams and QUIC.

days.title: Service interfaces checkpoint
days.objective: Bring APIs, contracts, and connections together.

days.title: Recall distributed stores
days.objective: Compare partition keys and consistency choices.

days.title: Prepare the read API
days.objective: Recall edge caching and clean inputs before you build.

days.title: Build the expiring cache
days.objective: Serve cached reads, expire stale entries, and fall back to storage.

parts.title: Keep services running
parts.description: Decouple work with queues, survive failures, and make every state change safe.

days.title: Choose how services talk
days.objective: Compare request-response, messaging, and streaming.

days.title: Put a queue between them
days.objective: Absorb bursts and retry safely with a message queue.

days.title: Apply a fixed-window limit
days.objective: Count requests per window and reject the overflow.

days.title: Stream events in order
days.objective: Partition a log so consumers scale while order holds.

days.title: Route messages to workers
days.objective: Use exchanges, queues, and acknowledgements.

days.title: Recall async basics
days.objective: Revisit interaction styles and simple limits.

days.title: Queue in the cloud
days.objective: Handle visibility timeouts, duplicates, and dead letters.

days.title: React to events
days.objective: Design producers and consumers around facts that happened.

days.title: Refill a token bucket
days.objective: Allow bursts while holding a steady average rate.

days.title: Run long workflows reliably
days.objective: Keep multi-step work correct across crashes and retries.

days.title: Recall delivery guarantees
days.objective: Compare at-least-once, at-most-once, and ordering.

days.title: Async systems checkpoint
days.objective: Bring queues, streams, and workflows together.

days.title: Put a server in front
days.objective: Terminate connections, serve static files, and proxy requests.

days.title: Balance the load
days.objective: Spread traffic and remove unhealthy targets.

days.title: Count a sliding window
days.objective: Smooth limits across window edges.

days.title: Limit the traffic
days.objective: Protect a service with the right limiting algorithm.

days.title: Recall rate limits
days.objective: Revisit bucket refills and limiter choices.

days.title: Fail fast, recover safely
days.objective: Stop calling a failing dependency, then probe for recovery.

days.title: Coordinate concurrent work
days.objective: Avoid races with locks, queues, and immutable data.

days.title: Enforce a per-tenant budget
days.objective: Admit a batch of requests without letting one tenant starve the rest.

days.title: Break it on purpose
days.objective: Inject failure to learn how the system really behaves.

days.title: Recall failure handling
days.objective: Revisit breakers and balancers with fresh scenarios.

days.title: Resilient services checkpoint
days.objective: Combine proxies, limits, breakers, and chaos.

days.title: Recognize a retried operation
days.objective: Detect a repeated request and return the earlier result.

days.title: Reject a stale write
days.objective: Use versions so a late update cannot overwrite a newer one.

days.title: Recall safe traffic
days.objective: Revisit concurrency and fair admission.

days.title: Reconcile versioned records
days.objective: Merge two copies of a record without losing the newest change.

days.title: Recall exactly-once
days.objective: Connect event delivery with idempotent handling.

days.title: Prepare the event applier
days.objective: Recall workflow state and version checks before you build.

days.title: Apply events exactly once
days.objective: Replay an event stream into state without duplicates or stale writes.

parts.title: Ship complete systems
parts.description: Operate and secure a service, then design complete systems end to end.

days.title: Split the monolith carefully
days.objective: Extract a service only when the boundary and ownership are clear.

days.title: Package the service
days.objective: Build an image that runs the same everywhere.

days.title: Calculate bounded retry delays
days.objective: Back off exponentially without retrying forever.

days.title: Run containers at scale
days.objective: Schedule, scale, and heal workloads.

days.title: Agree on configuration
days.objective: Store cluster state with a consistent key-value store.

days.title: Recall packaging and retries
days.objective: Revisit images and retry delays.

days.title: Measure the service
days.objective: Collect metrics and alert on what users feel.

days.title: See the service
days.objective: Turn metrics into dashboards people act on.

days.title: Production checkpoint
days.objective: Bring containers, orchestration, and observability together.

days.title: Schedule only ready jobs
days.objective: Pick jobs whose time and dependencies are satisfied.

days.title: Delegate access safely
days.objective: Let users grant limited access without sharing passwords.

days.title: Carry identity in a token
days.objective: Sign claims so services can verify them without a lookup.

days.title: Recall operations
days.objective: Revisit metrics and orchestration.

days.title: Run an identity provider
days.objective: Centralize login, roles, and tokens.

days.title: Keep secrets secret
days.objective: Issue, rotate, and revoke credentials.

days.title: Separate retries from dead letters
days.objective: Decide which failed jobs to retry and which to park.

days.title: Defend the web layer
days.objective: Block injection, cross-site attacks, and session abuse.

days.title: Recall identity
days.objective: Revisit delegation and token verification.

days.title: Security checkpoint
days.objective: Combine identity, secrets, and web defenses.

days.title: Run a design conversation
days.objective: Clarify, estimate, design, and deepen in order.

days.title: Design a URL shortener
days.objective: Apply the method to the system you built in your first month.

days.title: Recall job handling
days.objective: Revisit scheduling and dead letters.

days.title: Design a chat system
days.objective: Deliver messages in order with presence and fan-out.

days.title: Design a distributed cache
days.objective: Partition, replicate, and evict at scale.

days.title: Design a payment system
days.objective: Move money with idempotency, ledgers, and reconciliation.

days.title: Design a notification system
days.objective: Fan out to channels with priorities and retries.

days.title: Design lab checkpoint
days.objective: Bring five complete designs together.

days.title: Recall defenses
days.objective: Revisit secrets and web-layer protections.

days.title: Recall the design method
days.objective: Revisit the framework with a fresh scenario before you build.

days.title: Build a bounded worker plan
days.objective: Combine backoff, readiness, and dead letters into one worker plan.

parts.title: Learn from real systems
parts.description: Study four production systems, then connect everything you built.

days.title: How WhatsApp delivers messages
days.objective: See ordering, presence, and fan-out at global scale.

days.title: How Netflix streams
days.objective: Follow encoding, edge delivery, and resilience.

days.title: Compare chat designs
days.objective: Set your chat design beside a real one.

days.title: How GitHub collaborates
days.objective: Store, serve, and secure repositories at scale.

days.title: How Uber matches rides
days.objective: Locate, match, and price in real time.

days.title: Recall delivery pipelines
days.objective: Connect notification design with the worker you built.

days.title: Recall money-safe state
days.objective: Connect payment design with exactly-once event handling.

days.title: Recall the cache, end to end
days.objective: Connect your first cache with a distributed design.

days.title: Trace the whole system
days.objective: Follow one request through everything you learned.

days.title: Real systems checkpoint
days.objective: Bring the case studies together and finish the journey.

parts.title: Build with language models
parts.description: Understand how models predict text, shape prompts into contracts, and ground answers in retrieved evidence.

days.title: Predict one token at a time
days.objective: Separate the tokenizer, weights, context, and decoder, and see why a fluent continuation is not a verified claim.

days.title: Let tokens read each other
days.objective: Follow queries, keys, and values through one block, and see what the visibility mask is allowed to hide.

days.title: The bundle, not the name
days.objective: Trace weights, adaptation, prompt, decoding, and safety controls as the single bundle that decides product behavior.

days.title: Turn text into IDs
days.objective: Walk the normalize, split, segment, and post-process pipeline that maps a raw string into model input.

days.title: Merge the frequent pairs
days.objective: Learn subword pieces from ranked merges, and see why merge order and ID assignment are part of the contract.

days.title: Recall what fills the context
days.objective: Connect the context window with the tokenizer that decides how much of a request actually fits inside it.

days.title: Pin the tokenizer to the model
days.objective: Release tokenizer, checkpoint, template, and special-token IDs together so a faster encoder cannot quietly change the interface.

days.title: Language models checkpoint
days.objective: Bring tokens, transformers, and model bundles together.

days.title: Write the input contract
days.objective: State the task, permitted evidence, rules, and output shape, then measure the prompt version before it ships.

days.title: Carry state across turns
days.objective: Bind every turn to one authorized session and assemble only the memory and evidence that turn may use.

days.title: The model proposes, code decides
days.objective: Validate arguments and check authority before a tool proposal is allowed to touch a real system.

days.title: Suggest while someone types
days.objective: Treat no suggestion as a healthy outcome and keep a stale completion from landing in a newer draft.

days.title: Keep the meaning intact
days.objective: Protect numbers, names, and placeholders, and release target text only while the source still supports it.

days.title: Recall the output boundary
days.objective: Set a validated prompt schema beside a validated tool call and see the same trust boundary drawn twice.

days.title: Prompts and tools checkpoint
days.objective: Bring prompts, conversations, and tool boundaries together.

days.title: Give the model an open book
days.objective: See how retrieved passages replace a training cutoff with knowledge an index can refresh at any time.

days.title: Index offline, answer online
days.objective: Publish a versioned searchable snapshot so each request answers from passages it can point back to.

days.title: Add a stage per failure
days.objective: Slice the misses of a single-pass baseline, then add the smallest rewrite, fusion, or routing step that closes one gap.

days.title: Store facts as typed edges
days.objective: Model entities and directed relationships so every accepted claim stays traceable to evidence, policy, and time.

days.title: Abstain when evidence is thin
days.objective: Run the knowledge loop and the answer loop so each claim maps to versioned evidence or the system stops.

days.title: Recall two kinds of evidence
days.objective: Compare a packet of retrieved passages with a graph of typed facts and see which questions each one can answer.

days.title: Rank, filter, then cite
days.objective: Trade recall against a limited context budget, apply access filters before generation, and refuse claims the packet cannot support.

days.title: Search by nearest neighbor
days.objective: Keep identity, tenant filters, and index freshness around embeddings so approximate search still returns authorized records.

days.title: Retrieval checkpoint
days.objective: Bring indexes, evidence, and grounded answers together.

parts.title: Run agents and serving
parts.description: Give tool-using systems bounded authority, then serve and adapt models under a real budget.

days.title: Make a run survive a restart
days.objective: Give every run a bounded authority, deadline, and durable identity so a retry never becomes a second operation.

days.title: Loop until a stopping condition
days.objective: Wrap the model in an execution loop while deterministic controls decide which proposed action may actually run.

days.title: Capability is not authority
days.objective: Connect hosts, clients, and servers over one protocol, then decide separately which servers and tokens deserve trust.

days.title: Let the runtime decide
days.objective: Reach for an agentic loop only when the path is genuinely uncertain, and keep budgets, durable state, and stop rules in ordinary software.

days.title: Drive a screen safely
days.objective: Read a screenshot as a proposal, then confirm each postcondition from fresh evidence after the click lands.

days.title: Recall where trust is granted
days.objective: Set an agent tool loop beside a protocol handshake and see that neither one grants permission by itself.

days.title: Adapt without keeping everything
days.objective: Let authorized signals shape depth, format, and evidence while the profile stays inspectable and deletable.

days.title: Agent systems checkpoint
days.objective: Bring reasoning loops, tools, protocols, and application state together.

days.title: One request, one deadline
days.objective: Follow a model call from admission through prefill, decode, and streaming while one request identity and one deadline hold every hop together.

days.title: Budget the context window
days.objective: Reserve fixed instructions and output space first, then spend what is left on history, tools, and retrieved evidence.

days.title: Measure before you tune
days.objective: Keep queue delay, prefill, and decode cadence as separate measurements so a faster kernel cannot hide a longer wait or a broken answer.

days.title: Guard the model boundary
days.objective: Bind identity, budget, residency, and safety at the gateway, then rank on quality and cost only among routes that are already eligible.

days.title: Admit only finishable work
days.objective: Choose between synchronous, asynchronous, streaming, and composed serving, then reject the work the fleet cannot complete inside its contract.

days.title: Recall the cost of context
days.objective: See how the token envelope you allocate turns into prefill work and KV cache pressure on a real accelerator.

days.title: Spend more only when it pays
days.objective: Decide when extra candidates, tool calls, or verification passes earn their place inside a single deadline and cost envelope.

days.title: Fit the model on the fleet
days.objective: Shard weights, size the KV cache, and interleave prefill with decode inside a declared memory, latency, and availability envelope.

days.title: Serving models checkpoint
days.objective: Bring token budgets, gateways, batching, and inference scaling together.

days.title: Decide whether to train
days.objective: Rule out prompting and retrieval first, then ship a fine-tuned artifact only with held-out evidence, exact format lineage, and a tested rollback target.

days.title: Train a small adapter
days.objective: Freeze the base weights and learn a low-rank delta, choosing rank, alpha, and target modules on purpose rather than by habit.

days.title: Practice with the open book
days.objective: Train on oracle and distractor documents together so the generator learns the retrieval conditions it will actually meet in production.

days.title: Model adaptation checkpoint
days.objective: Bring fine-tuning judgment, adapters, and retrieval-aware training together.

parts.title: Work beyond text
parts.description: Generate and read images, video, and documents without losing traceable evidence.

days.title: Put words and images together
days.objective: Encode image and text on separate towers, then compare them in one normalized space to retrieve or classify without training a new head.

days.title: Turn a prompt into pixels
days.objective: Follow text encoding, a seeded noisy latent, guided denoising, and decoding, treating the prompt as a conditioning signal rather than a pixel specification.

days.title: Budget the denoising steps
days.objective: Fix the model and sampler contract, bound steps against a deadline, and keep the publication decision outside the generative model.

days.title: Ship the image as a job
days.objective: Admit an idempotent generation job, route it to compatible GPU capacity, and record policy, configuration, and durable delivery before calling it finished.

days.title: Keep the subject consistent
days.objective: Condition a timeline with reference frames, poses, and camera paths so a subject changes when the brief asks and not by accident.

days.title: Recall one frame to many
days.objective: See which parts of the still-image pipeline carry straight over to video and where continuity across frames adds new work.

days.title: Vision and generation checkpoint
days.objective: Bring shared image-text embeddings, diffusion, and governed generation systems together.

days.title: Say only what you see
days.objective: Write captions where every claim is supported by permitted image evidence, and omit, qualify, or escalate when the evidence is weak.

days.title: Trace a claim to its source
days.objective: Keep each modality as its own kind of evidence so a missing, sampled, or conflicting source never reads as verified.

days.title: Separate likely from grounded
days.objective: Split what the decoder finds probable from what the image actually supports, then measure hallucination, coverage, safety, and slices independently.

days.title: Compress an image into tokens
days.objective: Sample global and detail patches into a bounded set of visual tokens and interleave them with text in source order.

days.title: Tile the page, keep order
days.objective: Pick a dynamic tile layout and position encoding that tie every visual token to its image, tile, or frame inside the serving budget.

days.title: Recall the visual token budget
days.objective: Compare two ways of turning pixels into a bounded token sequence and see what each one risks losing.

days.title: Route text and image tokens
days.objective: Follow a text or visual token through a sparse layer and keep routing, capacity, overflow, and communication observable per modality.

days.title: Multimodal systems checkpoint
days.objective: Bring grounded captioning, vision-language architectures, and sparse routing together.

days.title: Keep the page in the record
days.objective: Recover text, layout, tables, and reading order while every extracted item keeps its page region, parser version, and validation result.

days.title: Gate the extracted value
days.objective: Route each document family to the right extraction path, then let a versioned policy accept, review, or quarantine a candidate without overwriting history.

days.title: Never curate on one score
days.objective: Keep quality, safety, provenance, and representation as separate signals bound to content hashes and a versioned release manifest.

days.title: Documents and data checkpoint
days.objective: Bring layout parsing, extraction quality gates, and dataset curation together.

parts.title: Prove GenAI works
parts.description: Measure quality with benchmarks, judges, and pipelines that survive drift.

days.title: Build a benchmark portfolio
days.objective: Assemble public benchmarks, product tasks, risk suites, and human review behind one release claim.

days.title: Score with a model judge
days.objective: Write a rubric another reviewer could apply, then calibrate the judge against human labels.

days.title: Find the usable window
days.objective: Sweep input length and evidence position to find where retrieval and citation still hold.

days.title: Score the whole trajectory
days.objective: Verify what an agent actually changed outside the model instead of trusting its success message.

days.title: Automate the release gate
days.objective: Chain offline checks, gates, canary exposure, and live outcomes into one reproducible decision.

days.title: Recall what a score proves
days.objective: See where a frozen benchmark stops and a written rubric has to take over.

days.title: Store the evidence trail
days.objective: Keep every result traceable to its dataset, configuration, judge, and approver.

days.title: Why the score moved
days.objective: Separate a product change from a judge change, a traffic change, and broken instrumentation.

days.title: Measuring behavior checkpoint
days.objective: Bring benchmarks, judges, pipelines, and drift detection together.

days.title: Probe everyday reasoning
days.objective: Read a multiple-choice common-sense score as evidence about its items and answer format only.

days.title: Open book or closed
days.objective: Match each question set's evidence contract to the factual claim the product makes.

days.title: Grade the math answer
days.objective: Freeze the task set, prompt, decoding budget, and verifier before comparing math scores.

days.title: Run the generated code
days.objective: Execute sampled programs against a versioned test contract and report pass@k with its denominator.

days.title: One exam, many subjects
days.objective: Trace a single headline percentage back to per-subject counts and their uncertainty.

days.title: Recall the multiple-choice limits
days.objective: See how option format and contamination can inflate two very differently sized exams.

days.title: Let people vote
days.objective: Read a blinded pairwise ranking as relative evidence about opponents, prompts, and voters.

days.title: Reasoning benchmarks checkpoint
days.objective: Bring reasoning, knowledge, code, and human preference evidence together.

parts.title: Ship GenAI responsibly
parts.description: Test for harm, monitor and govern production systems, then design one end to end.

days.title: Put limits outside the model
days.objective: Keep access, execution, and shutdown decisions in controls the model cannot move.

days.title: Test harm by slice
days.objective: Hold harm type, affected group, severity, and uncertainty visible until the release call.

days.title: Attack your own product
days.objective: Search the whole product path for a way an attacker reaches a protected asset.

days.title: Gate on the worst slice
days.objective: Let one failed critical gate block a release that a favorable average would pass.

days.title: Catch implicit hate
days.objective: Report missed harmful content and blocked legitimate speech as two separate costs.

days.title: Recall the trust boundary
days.objective: Look at the boundaries you enforce from the attacker's side of them.

days.title: Compare groups fairly
days.objective: Put groups under the same task, prompt meaning, and scorer before reporting a gap.

days.title: Resist the popular answer
days.objective: Prefer a qualified answer or an honest abstention to a fluent, unsupported one.

days.title: Check the attack is valid
days.objective: Count a perturbed input as a failure only when it preserves the tested intent.

days.title: Recall the failing slice
days.objective: Watch a group-level rate turn into the gate that holds back a release.

days.title: Safety and robustness checkpoint
days.objective: Bring guardrails, bias evidence, and adversarial testing together.

days.title: Watch more than uptime
days.objective: Notice a request that returns 200 while the answer is ungrounded, slow, or expensive.

days.title: Ship behind a rollback
days.objective: Give a versioned serving path only the traffic its evidence and capacity justify.

days.title: Keep authority outside the agent
days.objective: Authorize every agent side effect against the current user, bound it, and keep it recoverable.

days.title: Make the decision auditable
days.objective: Connect each system version and risk to an owner, evidence, control, and follow-up.

days.title: Recall the release loop
days.objective: Follow one live signal into an abort, a rollback, or a wider rollout.

days.title: Operating AI checkpoint
days.objective: Bring monitoring, deployment, agent security, and governance together.

days.title: Write the design contract
days.objective: Trace every architecture choice to a requirement, measurable evidence, and stated failure behavior.

days.title: Answer an open prompt
days.objective: Move a broad GenAI question through requirements, data, model, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

days.title: How Gmail finishes sentences
days.objective: Keep typing ahead of inference and discard any suggestion that arrives late, stale, or weak.

days.title: Compare process and product
days.objective: Set the design contract you wrote beside a shipped system that lives by one.

days.title: GenAI design checkpoint
days.objective: Bring the design process, the interview framework, and the case study together to close the GenAI path.

parts.title: Frame machine learning problems
parts.description: Decide what to predict, build the data path that feeds it, and keep the corpus trustworthy.

days.title: Learn a rule from examples
days.objective: See how data, model, training, and inference form one versioned behavior that is only useful if it holds on cases it never trained on.

days.title: Decide or describe the data
days.objective: Choose the narrowest learning objective that still produces the output the product consumes, and learn a full data distribution only when something uses it.

days.title: Decide whether ML fits
days.objective: Judge when learned patterns beat plain rules, then turn the business need into a task shape with metrics and constraints attached.

days.title: Write the system contract
days.objective: State the decision being improved, the evidence available at prediction time, the latency and cost promise, and what happens when the model is unavailable.

days.title: Prove the model generalizes
days.objective: Pair offline splits and significance tests with shadow traffic, canaries, and A/B runs so a promotion rests on both kinds of evidence.

days.title: Recall the success metric
days.objective: Revisit how framing chooses the metric and how evaluation gathers the evidence that the chosen metric actually moved.

days.title: Learning problem checkpoint
days.objective: Bring framing, model family, system contract, and evaluation together in one pass over the unit.

days.title: Feed training and serving alike
days.objective: Give the offline and online paths one lineage, one time semantics, and one set of reproducible transformations so a feature means the same thing on both sides.

days.title: Make a rerun repeat
days.objective: Treat every stage as a contract so retries and backfills over the same interval commit the same output instead of duplicating, dropping, or reinterpreting records.

days.title: Pin a dataset manifest
days.objective: Resolve each trained model back to one immutable manifest naming its source snapshots, transformations, labels, splits, checks, and permissions.

days.title: Build features that survive serving
days.objective: Hold every feature to four tests: available at prediction time, reproducible offline and online, useful on a holdout, and owned by someone.

days.title: Guard the test set
days.objective: Write a dataset contract for task, rights, coverage, and quality, then keep the final test set out of every development decision it could bias.

days.title: Recall reproducible inputs
days.objective: See that a feature definition is only reproducible because the pipeline underneath it fixes versions, windows, and event times.

days.title: Split before you transform
days.objective: Cut on the deployment boundary first, fit imputation, scaling, and vocabularies on training rows only, and keep rejected records as versioned evidence.

days.title: Prototype tables in pandas
days.objective: Explore and reshape DataFrames while naming the column, dtype, key, and boundary contracts that pandas will happily execute but never enforce.

days.title: Data foundation checkpoint
days.objective: Bring pipelines, dataset versioning, feature contracts, and leakage-safe preparation together in one pass over the unit.

days.title: Where the corpus comes from
days.objective: Write a corpus contract covering purpose, permission, and provenance before treating reachable web text, books, or code as training material.

days.title: Keep, quarantine, or review
days.objective: Make each disposition explainable by source snapshot, policy version, gate version, and reason code instead of by a single opaque quality score.

days.title: Teach behavior with examples
days.objective: Curate instruction and response pairs so every accepted record teaches an intended behavior and closes a measured coverage gap.

days.title: Turn files into records
days.objective: Follow one document from safe ingestion through OCR, structure recovery, and typed schemas without ever separating a value from its source and decision state.

days.title: Name the regions on a page
days.objective: Detect titles, text blocks, lists, tables, and figures as typed regions that carry their page, coordinates, class, confidence, and reading order.

days.title: Recall the decision trail
days.objective: Compare how a quality filter and a document parser each keep the reason a record was published, quarantined, or sent to a human.

days.title: Route by document format
days.objective: Match the parser route to what the file actually is, and pay for OCR, table analysis, and attachment recursion only when the output contract needs them.

days.title: Training data curation checkpoint
days.objective: Bring sourcing, filtering, demonstrations, and document extraction together in one pass over the unit.

parts.title: Train and shrink models
parts.description: Fit models, prove they generalize, then make them small enough to serve.

days.title: Run training as an experiment
days.objective: Freeze the dataset version, split rule, code revision, and seeds so a promoted checkpoint improves a protected validation measure rather than only training loss.

days.title: Attribute one prediction
days.objective: Produce SHAP contributions or a LIME surrogate while naming the output explained, the reference population, and how the attribution was tested for stability.

days.title: Predict the next token
days.objective: Follow a prompt through tokenization, logits, and decoding, and see why the most likely continuation is a best guess and not a verified fact.

days.title: Reward the better action
days.objective: Raise the probability of actions that beat expectation, and subtract a state-only baseline to cut variance without changing the expected gradient.

days.title: Learn from human preferences
days.objective: Turn pairwise comparisons into a reward model, then constrain the policy update so it cannot exploit biased labels or an overreaching reward.

days.title: Recall tokens as actions
days.objective: Read the same model twice, once as a next-token predictor and once as a policy whose sampled outputs earn a learning signal.

days.title: Training and explanation checkpoint
days.objective: Bring optimization, attribution, language modeling, and preference tuning together in one pass over the unit.

days.title: Score reasoning, not fluency
days.objective: Keep final-answer correctness, checkable steps, robustness, and cost as separate measurements so a fluent explanation is never read as proof.

days.title: Test what the model knows
days.objective: Write an item blueprint that fixes domain, time boundary, and access mode before any accuracy number is allowed to mean something.

days.title: Combine many test scores
days.objective: Normalize direction and scale, apply declared weights, and publish the component profile beside the single number it hides.

days.title: Split live traffic fairly
days.objective: Assign real users to a control or candidate experience by a stable rule and decide from a contract written before traffic starts.

days.title: Recall offline against live evidence
days.objective: See why an aggregate benchmark can rank two candidates while only a running experiment measures the whole product path.

days.title: Beyond one score checkpoint
days.objective: Bring reasoning suites, knowledge blueprints, composite scores, and online experiments together.

days.title: Budget the whole request
days.objective: Spend a latency budget across feature lookup, queueing, inference, and post-processing under one tested version contract.

days.title: Shrink the number format
days.objective: Map real values onto an integer grid with a scale and zero point, then measure what the runtime actually gains from the smaller codes.

days.title: Teach a smaller student
days.objective: Train a cheap student on a frozen teacher's output distribution and still release it against its own quality, latency, and memory gates.

days.title: Pick the compression that fits
days.objective: Name the binding deployment constraint first, then choose pruning, factorization, or precision changes the target backend can really execute.

days.title: Keep attention off HBM
days.objective: Tile queries, keys, and values through on-chip memory so exact attention never writes the full score matrix back to device memory.

days.title: Recall where the time goes
days.objective: See why a faster attention kernel helps only when the model, not feature retrieval or batch waiting, owns the request budget.

days.title: Efficient models checkpoint
days.objective: Bring serving budgets, quantization, distillation, and memory-aware kernels together.

parts.title: Operate models at scale
parts.description: Handle drift, keep people in the loop, and train and serve across many machines.

days.title: Notice the world moved
days.objective: Compare a frozen reference window with current traffic and diagnose the cause before treating an alert as proof the model failed.

days.title: Watch four health planes
days.objective: Attribute every actionable prediction to a model version, feature version, serving context, and eventual outcome so a 200 response cannot hide a failing product.

days.title: Learn without forgetting
days.objective: Trade plasticity against stability by mixing bounded replay into an update and testing retained tasks beside the new one.

days.title: Route a case to a person
days.objective: Build a routing policy from risk, novelty, and reviewer capacity, and keep the review that resolves a case separate from the label that trains the next model.

days.title: Ship the model to a device
days.objective: Hold one signed model, runtime, and preprocessing path inside the measured memory, deadline, and rollback limits of every supported device cohort.

days.title: Recall drift and adaptation
days.objective: Follow one confirmed shift into a curated update set instead of letting the alert trigger retraining by itself.

days.title: Changing model checkpoint
days.objective: Bring drift investigation, monitoring, human review, and edge releases together.

days.title: Keep every rank in step
days.objective: Partition the batch, optimizer state, or layers across accelerators and hold one coherent global step through the collectives that rejoin them.

days.title: Route tokens to experts
days.objective: Send each token to a few experts within their per-batch capacity and combine the weighted results without losing the tokens that overflow.

days.title: Answer inside the deadline
days.objective: Assemble fresh features, inference, and business rules into one path that trades tail latency against freshness, cost, and graceful degradation.

days.title: Give every model an owner
days.objective: Trace a production behavior back to an owned project, an immutable bundle, the evidence that approved it, and a known recovery path.

days.title: React to bursty events
days.objective: Let a short-lived function claim each event exactly once and hand the durable ML work to managed compute that outlives the handler.

days.title: Recall sparse serving costs
days.objective: See how expert dispatch and capacity overflow land straight in the tail latency a real-time path has to hold.

days.title: Training and inference checkpoint
days.objective: Bring distributed steps, sparse experts, real-time paths, and platform contracts together.

parts.title: Apply machine learning
parts.description: Build perception and language systems, meet real-world constraints, and finish at the frontier.

days.title: Turn frames into decisions
days.objective: Carry pixels through capture, decode, inference, and product policy so every admitted frame either answers inside its deadline or meets an explicit drop rule.

days.title: Keep text and versions together
days.objective: Follow one request through admission, tokenization, batching, and decision, keeping the representation and model versions attached to the outcome.

days.title: Retrieve, rank, then shape the slate
days.objective: Narrow a catalog in stages and log exposure so a recommendation stays attributable to its candidate source, model version, and final position.

days.title: Recall first, then reorder
days.objective: Blend term matching, vector neighbors, and fail-closed permission filters, because ranking can only reorder the candidates retrieval already found.

days.title: Decide where modalities meet
days.objective: Write an evidence contract for each input, choose a fusion point, and name who owns the decision when one modality arrives late or never.

days.title: Recall two-stage retrieval
days.objective: Set a feed beside a search page and see one funnel: a wide cheap recall stage quietly decides what the expensive ranker is ever allowed to order.

days.title: Perception and language checkpoint
days.objective: Bring the vision, language, recommendation, search, and multimodal pipelines together in one pass.

days.title: Stay inside the validated boundary
days.objective: Write the intended-use contract for a clinical workflow and keep uncertainty, provenance, and a human fallback visible whenever a case falls outside it.

days.title: Decide with only past evidence
days.objective: Rebuild a money decision from the information available at that timestamp, then keep the model score separate from permission to approve, decline, or price.

days.title: Close the loop safely
days.objective: Follow sensor evidence through belief, plan, and control, and keep deterministic limits standing between an uncertain model and an unsafe physical action.

days.title: Learn where the physics allows
days.objective: Use a learned model as a surrogate, an inverse solver, or a closure term, and judge it by credible behavior in the regime where the decision is made.

days.title: Handle late and duplicate events
days.objective: Use event time, watermarks, checkpointed state, and idempotent effect keys so a replayed correction updates a window without paging anyone twice.

days.title: Recall time-honest evidence
days.objective: Put point-in-time feature rows beside event-time windows and see one discipline at work: a result is only as trustworthy as the clock that assembled its inputs.

days.title: Fail closed on consequences
days.objective: Wrap a model in a risk contract and independent controls so a missing or uncertain check never silently grants high-impact authority.

days.title: ML in the real world checkpoint
days.objective: Bring the clinical, financial, autonomous, scientific, streaming, and safety constraints of this unit together.

days.title: The runtime holds authority
days.objective: Run an agent as a bounded observe, propose, authorize, execute loop where the runtime rather than the plan decides which external effect is allowed.

days.title: Match the claim to evidence
days.objective: Route a question to symbolic proof, causal estimation, or fast adaptation, and abstain when the representation cannot support the kind of conclusion asked for.

days.title: Let the search pick layers
days.objective: Score candidate architectures under one versioned protocol against a stated deployment envelope, then retrain the finalists free of the proxy that selected them.

days.title: Train where the data lives
days.objective: Send a training round out to selected clients instead of copying their examples in, and still treat every update, aggregate, and released model as sensitive.

days.title: Imagine before you act
days.objective: Learn dynamics an agent can roll forward under candidate actions, and measure the model by decision usefulness rather than how real its predictions look.

days.title: Recall the bounded plan
days.objective: Set imagined rollouts beside the agent runtime and notice that a plan drawn from a learned model still earns nothing until it is checked against fresh state.

days.title: Give motion a safety gate
days.objective: Convert a policy proposal into actuator commands only after independent checks find it fresh, feasible, inside the operating envelope, and interruptible.

days.title: Compute only on change
days.objective: See when event-driven spiking hardware skips real work, and how dense encoding, spike storms, or format conversion erase the saving before a decision arrives.

days.title: Weigh a quantum claim
days.objective: Count state preparation, circuit depth, and measurement shots across the whole path, then compare the result against a tuned classical baseline at matched quality.

days.title: Recall hardware-measured claims
days.objective: Compare an architecture search envelope with an event-driven efficiency argument and see that both are settled only by measurement on the real target path.

days.title: Advanced architectures checkpoint
days.objective: Bring agents, reasoning, federated training, world models, robotics, and new hardware together, and finish the whole path across all four courses.

parts.title: Build what you learned
parts.description: Implement the request path and the release decision the last two courses described.

days.title: Budget the context window
days.objective: Reserve instructions and the answer first, then fit evidence into whatever tokens remain.

days.title: Fuse two ranked lists
days.objective: Combine retrievers by rank instead of raw score, and see that a document nobody found scores nothing.

days.title: Cut a document into chunks
days.objective: Advance by the stride rather than the chunk size, and let the final chunk be short.

days.title: Assemble an evidence packet
days.objective: Filter for authorization and freshness, drop repeated sources, fit the budget, and refuse when nothing survives.

days.title: Report precision and recall
days.objective: Compute each metric against its own denominator, and handle the case where nothing was flagged.

days.title: Split without leaking
days.objective: Divide records chronologically and discard the embargo window rather than assigning it to either side.

days.title: Find the biggest shift
days.objective: Compare shares rather than counts, so a busy day does not look like drift.

days.title: Decide the release
days.objective: Read the worst slice before the average, then promote, hold, or roll back.

days.title: Build an inference gateway
days.objective: Admit work against a token budget and a capacity limit, and give the slot back when a request finishes.
